selected_branch: Pedestrian on or near a highway, street or road
required_raw_sources: original Native 20 Hz vehicle and pedestrian actor poses, velocity, frame identities
original road boundary survey tied to the Native map
driver and motor vehicle control relationship
independent actual-observation source; geometric line of sight alone is insufficient
source_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical JSON trace rows is required and rechecked before measurement
interpretation: Speed, clearance and time to conflict are context only. They do not define a legal proper-caution threshold or prove actual observation.
unresolved: actual observation by the driver cannot be inferred from requested control or line of sight
near has no statutory distance; the on-road alternative is used in this draft
bus stop, transit boarding, school zone and crosswalk alternatives need separate controlled cases
